title: TypedBench: A Benchmark for Calibration, Framing Sensitivity, and Cost in System One Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.11392v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: System One models output calibrated probabilities over typed answers such as categorical choices, ordinal levels, or binary outcomes, via a non-generative interface. Software can act on these probabilities through thresholds, cost-weighted choices, and escalation rules. Consequently, if these probabilities are miscalibrated or wording-sensitive, the software ma take unintended actions leaving human operators with no textual rationale to inspect. Current evaluations largely report accuracy and calibration on public classification datasets without a clear reference. We present TypedBench, a benchmark for typed decision models like Jev built from seven policy-labelled generators and nine evaluation suites. We report accuracy as median and range across paraphrases, and calibration error relative to the finite-sample noise floor of a matched, perfectly calibrated predictor. translated_title: TypedBench：系统一决策模型中校准、措辞敏感性与成本的基准测试
translated_abstract: 系统一（System One）模型通过非生成式接口输出针对类型化答案（如分类选择、有序等级或二元结果）的校准概率。软件可以通过阈值、成本加权选择和升级规则对这些概率进行操作。因此，如果这些概率校准不良或对措辞敏感，软件可能会采取非预期的行动，而人类操作员却没有文本依据可供审查。目前的评估大多在公开分类数据集上报告准确率和校准情况，且缺乏明确的参照标准。我们提出了TypedBench，这是一个针对类型化决策模型（如Jev）的基准测试，由七个策略标注的生成器和九个评估套件构成。我们将准确率报告为各种改写表述下的中位数和范围，并将校准误差相对于匹配的完美校准预测器的有限样本噪声底限进行衡量。我们通过选择性预测、有序概……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了TypedBench基准测试，通过七种策略标注生成器和九个评估套件，以改写中位数范围和有限样本噪声底限为参照，系统评估系统一类型化决策模型的校准质量、措辞敏感性与决策成本。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces TypedBench, a benchmark built from seven policy-labelled generators and nine evaluation suites that systematically assesses calibration, framing sensitivity, and cost in System One typed decision models, reporting accuracy as median and range across paraphrases and calibration error relative to a finite-sample noise floor.
